mathPatches.name: supertrend
mathPatches.description: BTH-Script v3 Native Supertrend Engine with NaN Guard
mathPatches.code: function(factor, atrPeriod) { const len = close.length; const supertrend = new Array(len).fill(NaN); const direction = new Array(len).fill(1); const atr = ta.atr(atrPeriod || 10); const upperBand = new Array(len).fill(0); const lowerBand = new Array(len).fill(0); let startIdx = 0; while (startIdx < len && (isNaN(atr[startIdx]) || atr[startIdx] === undefined)) { startIdx++; } if (startIdx >= len) { const res = [supertrend, direction]; res.supertrend = supertrend; res.direction = direction; return res; } for (let i = startIdx; i < len; i++) { const hl2 = (high[i] + low[i]) / 2; const basicUpper = hl2 + (factor || 3) * atr[i]; const basicLower = hl2 - (factor || 3) * atr[i]; if (i === startIdx) { upperBand[i] = basicUpper; lowerBand[i] = basicLower; direction[i] = 1; supertrend[i] = lowerBand[i]; continue; } upperBand[i] = (basicUpper < upperBand[i - 1] || close[i - 1] > upperBand[i - 1]) ? basicUpper : upperBand[i - 1]; lowerBand[i] = (basicLower > lowerBand[i - 1] || close[i - 1] < lowerBand[i - 1]) ? basicLower : lowerBand[i - 1]; let dir = direction[i - 1]; if (dir === 1 && close[i] < lowerBand[i]) { dir = -1; } else if (dir === -1 && close[i] > upperBand[i]) { dir = 1; } direction[i] = dir; supertrend[i] = dir === 1 ? lowerBand[i] : upperBand[i]; } const res = [supertrend, direction]; res.supertrend = supertrend; res.direction = direction; return res; }

mathPatches.name: vwma
mathPatches.code: function(source, length) { const len = length || 20; const src = source || close; const vol = volume; const res = new Array(src.length).fill(NaN); let pvSum = 0; let vSum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) { pvSum += src[i] * vol[i]; vSum += vol[i]; if (i >= len) { pvSum -= src[i - len] * vol[i - len]; vSum -= vol[i - len]; } if (i >= len - 1) { res[i] = vSum !== 0 ? pvSum / vSum : src[i]; } } return res; }

mathPatches.name: rma
mathPatches.description: BTH-Script v3 Running Moving Average (Wilder's Smoothing)
mathPatches.code: function(source, length) { const len = length || 14; const src = source || close; const alpha = 1 / len; const res = new Array(src.length).fill(NaN); let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < len && i < src.length; i++) { sum += src[i]; } if (src.length >= len) { res[len - 1] = sum / len; for (let i = len; i < src.length; i++) { res[i] = alpha * src[i] + (1 - alpha) * res[i - 1]; } } return res; }

mathPatches.name: zscore
mathPatches.code: function(source, length) { const len = length || 20; const src = source || close; const sma = ta.sma(src, len); const stdev = ta.stdev(src, len); const res = new Array(src.length).fill(NaN); for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) { if (!isNaN(sma[i]) && !isNaN(stdev[i]) && stdev[i] !== 0) { res[i] = (src[i] - sma[i]) / stdev[i]; } } return res; }
